title: Montra app entry
description: One curated Android app. This is the human-edited source of truth: one file per app under apps/<id>.json. The resolved, installable index (index.json) is generated from these files by tools/build-index.mjs.

id.description: Slug. MUST equal the file name (apps/<id>.json) and stay stable forever: it is the client-side identity of the app.

summary.description: One line, no trailing period. Shown in the list.

description.description: Longer description, keyed by BCP-47 language tag. At least 'en' is required.

packageName.description: Application ID exactly as declared in the APK manifest. Verified against the APK by CI.

license.description: Licença declarada. Referencialmente uma licença livre aprovada pela OSI/FSF, listada em oneOf[0]. Uma licença restritiva (código público mas com limitações de uso) só é aceite como LicenseRef-*, e obriga a antiFeatures:[restrictedLicense] e a licenseNote — o validador exige os três.

oneOf.description: Licença livre aprovada pela OSI ou FSF.
Licença restritiva, nomeada pelo repositório. Nunca é apresentada como livre.

licenseNote.description: Obrigatório quando license é LicenseRef-*: o que é que a licença permite e não permite, em linguagem que um utilizador entenda. Aparece na app, antes do botão de instalar.

sourceCode.description: Repository the APK is built from. Must be publicly readable.

forkOf.description: Parentesco declarado pelo próprio projeto (README, descrição do repositório ou site). Não é um palpite: se o projeto não o diz, não se escreve. Permite ao cliente ligar duas entradas do catálogo quando o original também está indexado.

appId.description: id no catálogo, quando o original também está indexado.

note.description: O que muda em relação ao original, em uma linha.

categories.description: Fixed taxonomy so the client can render stable filters. At most 3.

icon.description: Where the build should fetch a square icon from. Downloaded and re-hosted by the build under icons/<id>.png so the client never talks to third-party hosts. If omitted, the client renders a monogram.

screenshots.description: Up to 5 images, re-hosted by the build under screenshots/<id>/.

playStore.description: Whether the same app is also on Google Play. Informational: it lets the client label apps correctly and lets the build track Play-only exclusions.

antiFeatures.description: F-Droid-style warnings surfaced to the user before install.

verification.description: Trust anchors. signingCertSha256 pins the signing certificate: CI fails if a published APK is signed by a different key, which is what catches a hijacked or re-signed release.

notes.description: Maintainer-facing notes. Not shown in the client.

provider.description: github: resolve the newest release of a repo and pick APK assets. direct: a fixed APK URL. fdroid: an F-Droid repo entry. gitlab: GitLab release assets.

repo.description: owner/name. Required for github and gitlab.

assetPattern.description: Glob applied to release asset names. Must match exactly one asset, unless abiAssets or allowMultiple are used.

excludePattern.description: Glob of asset names to ignore (e.g. '*-debug.apk').

abiAssets.description: Per-ABI asset patterns, for apps that ship split APKs. Keys are ABI names plus 'universal'.

allowMultiple.description: Allow assetPattern to match more than one asset (e.g. per-ABI splits named inconsistently). Every match becomes an artifact.

tagPattern.description: Only consider tags matching this glob, e.g. 'v*'. Useful when a repo tags non-app releases.
